reports.title: Diversified Energy Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook
section: The Company is reiterating its previously announced Full Year 2026 guidance. Following the recently completed acquisitions and divestitures, Diversified expects to realize continued significant operational synergies associated with a larger, consolidated position in Oklahoma. The Birch acquisition is not included in the guidance figures below and remains on track to close during the fourth quarter 2026.
The guidance metrics for the Full Year 2026 are outlined in the table below:

Total Production (Mmcfe/d) | 1,180 to 1,210
% Liquids | ~29%
% Natural Gas | ~71%
Total Capital Expenditures (millions) | $225 to $255
Operated Development | $35 to $50
Non-Op JV Partnership | $115 to $125
Maintenance/Other | $75 to $80
Adj. EBITDA(a) (millions) | $960 to $1,010
Adj. Free Cash Flow(b) (millions) | ~$440
Income from equity affiliates(2) (millions) | ~$15
Leverage Target | 2.0x to 2.5x

(2)Income from equity affiliates included in Adjusted EBITDA and Adjusted Free Cash Flow consists of (i) distributions received from the operations of the Company's equity affiliates and (ii) management fees earned by the Company for services provided in its capacity as manager of the equity affiliates. Distributions received from equity affiliates are reflected in the Condensed Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, while management fees are reflected as a reduction of general and administrative expense in the Condensed Consolidated Statements of Comprehensive Income (Loss). Further information is provided in our Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q.
